propositions: Four graph functions (_find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked) have elevated cyclomatic complexity (16-22) due to duplicated reduce-and-filter loops and hand-rolled BFS traversal logic

Identical 'reduce_all → drop error/fsck → index by id' pattern is duplicated verbatim in _find_direct_blockers and _compute_dep_graph, and two distinct BFS skeletons are re-implemented in _get_all_blocked_by and check_cycle_at_level

Refactoring introduces load_indexed_states helper to eliminate the first duplication and bfs(starts, neighbors_fn) accumulator skeleton to replace both BFS implementations while preserving node-set and traversal results

The bfs contract must return an accumulator set that includes blocks targets with no backing ticket directory and excludes the seed node, to preserve _get_all_blocked_by and check_cycle_at_level behavior
All four functions must achieve CCN ≤ 8 (except detect_newly_unblocked ≤ 12) and existing tests must pass unchanged, with one new characterization test pinning the accumulator-vs-visited distinction
